name: Tuna Salad (1940)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ¼ cup mayonnaise (low fat can work)
½ each. chopped green onion or ½ tsp dried chopped white or yellow onion
1 hard boiled egg, chopped (or two hard boiled egg whites and a bit of oil olive oil to make up the difference)

steps: Drain and squeeze tuna dry, discarding liquid or reserving for some other use.
Combine tuna, apple, celery, mayonnaise, lemon juice, green onion, egg, and pepper.
Sprinkle with paprika and trim with lettuce, if desired.

culture.text: Tuna salad is a salad dish consisting of tuna and mayonnaise. The tuna used is usually pre-cooked, canned, and packaged in water or oil. Pickles, celery, relish, and onion are popular ingredients to add. Tuna salad is used to make tuna fish sandwiches; it can also be served on top of crackers, lettuce, tomato, or avocado.
